    dummy = tail = ListNode()
    carry = 0
    while l1 or l2 or carry:
        total = carry + (l1.val if l1 else 0) + (l2.val if l2 else 0)
        carry, digit = divmod(total, 10)

        l2 = l2.next if l2 else None

def add_two_numbers(l1, l2):
    def to_int(node):
        value, place = 0, 1
        while node:                    # digits are stored least significant first
            value += node.val * place
            place *= 10
            node = node.next
        return value

    total = to_int(l1) + to_int(l2)
    dummy = tail = ListNode()
    while True:
        total, digit = divmod(total, 10)
        tail.next = ListNode(digit)
        tail = tail.next
        if not total:
            return dummy.next

def copy_random_list(head):
    clones = {None: None}
    cur = head
    while cur:                         # pass 1: make every clone
        clones[cur] = Node(cur.val)
        cur = cur.next
    cur = head
    while cur:                         # pass 2: wire next and random
        clones[cur].next = clones[cur.next]
        clones[cur].random = clones[cur.random]
        cur = cur.next
    return clones[head]
